integrity: The two-sided oblique tangent formula and standard Gaussian ratio law are acknowledged as prior mathematics. The review covers the specifically defined correlated-sketch moment phase and near-sharing singularity only.
scientific_limitations: Exact real Gaussian sketches at a single rank-one positive matrix and a single perpendicular positive rank-one forcing; one-step symmetric-part correction; no claim for long-time dynamics, arbitrary matrices, other sketch laws or full integrator stability.
title: A sharp sketch-coupling singularity for symmetric oblique low-rank tangent projection
